newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end mostly up on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end mostly up on fresh buying.

text.p: Most Shanghai soybean futures contracts ended up on Tuesday on speculative buying from retail investors, traders said.
The most active September 1997 contract ended at 3,405 yuan ($410) per tonne, up 22 yuan. The contract opened at 3,380 yuan, hitting an intraday low of 3,375 and a high of 3,411.
The May contract rose 70 yuan to 3,450, while July rose seven yuan to close at 3,375. November fell eight yuan to end at 3,392, and the January 1998 contract put on 12 yuan to 3,410.
Combined volume rose to 25,700 tonnes from 15,200 tonnes the previous session.
